levels.surface: عبد الوهاب بن عبد الحكم الوراق

notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Sufyan: the text names him in both («سفيان بن سعيد» and «عن سفيان»), so each branch ends at him and the shared tail starts after him (Ibn al-Sa'ib, Zadhan, the Companion).
The archive flag (three or more routes) is answered by the reading: two branches only.
«عن عبد الله» at the end is the Companion Ibn Mas'ud's position as the text gives it: the name is written only as «عبد الله».
